notes: Full screen (F11) now hides the title strip properly
If Nexus Forge Gaming can't be reached, the app shows a clear offline page and reconnects by itself; if the page crashes, it reloads by itself
Safer: only nfgcord.com can use the desktop app's features, and camera, microphone and screen access are limited to it
Start with Windows is now off unless you switch it on (tray menu: Start with Windows)
Smaller download and an updated Electron with the latest security fixes

Known limitations in this beta: chat and direct messages can't be popped out yet, computer sound is not shared with the screen yet, and some strict networks may need a relay server that is not set up yet
